meta.title: Community
meta.description: MDDB America is built by the community, for the community. Ways to share data, develop tools, partner and get involved.

hero.label: Community
hero.title: Our **Community**
hero.text: MDDB America is built by the community, for the community. Join us in advancing open molecular dynamics data science.

label: Get Involved
title: Ways to Contribute
text: Whether you are a researcher, developer, or institution, there are many ways to contribute to and benefit from the MDDB America initiative.

ways.title: Share Your Data
ways.text: Contribute your molecular dynamics simulation datasets to the repository and make your research more impactful and reproducible.

ways.title: Develop Tools
ways.text: Help build and improve the tools, APIs, and infrastructure that power the MDDB America platform.

ways.title: Spread the Word
ways.text: Help grow our community by sharing MDDB America with colleagues, at conferences, and in your publications.

ways.title: Become a Partner
ways.text: Institutional partnerships help sustain and grow the platform. Reach out to explore partnership opportunities.

ways.title: Cite Our Work
ways.text:
Amaro, R. E. *et al.* The need to implement FAIR principles in biomolecular simulations. *Nature Methods* **22**, 641–645 (2025).\
[doi:10.1038/s41592-025-02635-0](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41592-025-02635-0)

ways.title: Join the Mailing List
ways.text: Stay informed about new datasets, platform updates, events, and opportunities to get involved.

cta.label: Contact
cta.title: Ready to Get **Involved?**
cta.text: Reach out to the MDDB America team and we'll find the best way for you or your institution to contribute.
